record.title: Validate a bounded ordered-write transcript consumer
record.intent: Execute only a predeclared finite command transcript while retaining complete access and thread observation.
requirements: Load a bounded versioned immutable transcript with exact size/count checks before tracing; reject malformed, oversized or trailing input.
Retain the existing two reads and continuous group observer; accept only exact ordered main-thread32-bit stores at the known PC/opcode and offset0x3000.
Record every accepted operand and all pre/post registers; only PC may advance and no memory backing or peripheral effect may be introduced.
Private controls cover complete transcript followed by main/worker access, changed value/offset, count exhaustion, a worker attempting the expected store and a wider store.
Re-run existing controls with the rebuilt executable and validate malformed-input rejection before target creation.
Preserve explicit thread/event/count/wall-clock bounds, checking the runtime deadline even during a nonempty event stream.
acceptance: Independent checks prove transcript ordering, exact response counts, register preservation, negative guards, thread attribution and complete successful cleanup.
Preserve enforcement/system_server and commit and push controls before stock execution.
